assertions.assertion: Uses UseSmtpOtpDispatcher() inside the AddUserManagement options lambda
assertions.rationale: The response builds a custom MailKit-based IEmailSender and never uses UseSmtpOtpDispatcher() or an AddUserManagement lambda.
It configures Host and Port (587/STARTTLS) both in appsettings and in the ConnectAsync call.

assertions.assertion: Configures from address for outgoing emails
assertions.rationale: A FromAddress (and FromName) is configured and used to build the MimeMessage.From.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT use ConsoleOtpDispatcher for production (or warns against it)
assertions.rationale: The solution is a real SMTP sender and never uses a console dispatcher for production.
